name: Target: Hive'Ashi Sandstalkers
label: Quest
description: Target: Hive'Ashi Sandstalkers: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As the war effort mounts, the silithid presence in the area presents an ever increasing threat to our operations. You've been selected to partake on an assault on Hive'Ashi where your primary target will consist of Hive'Ashi sandstalkers.
Report back to Commander Mar'alith after your task is completed.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have something to tell me, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent work, friend. Your part in the attack on Hive'Ashi has been noted.
